name: xm-system-functions
description: XM System — Firebase Cloud Functions (replaces Express.js server)

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.backfill:contractor-status: tsc scripts/backfill-contractor-status.ts --outDir lib/scripts --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --target es2017 --skipLibCheck --strict --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals && node lib/scripts/backfill-contractor-status.js
scripts.grant:admin: tsc scripts/grant_admin_claims.ts --outDir lib/scripts --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --target es2017 --skipLibCheck --strict --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals && node lib/scripts/grant_admin_claims.js
